Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
damo...@aol.com (Deviant One) wrote:
> Can a Caitiff become a Prince by calling a Praxis Seizure?

Yes. Caitiff, though clanless, are still members of the Camarilla.

> Can you use a Cryptic Rider on a vote that passes because of a Cryptic Rider?
> (first vote passes normally, cryptic rider to autopass the second vote, cryptic
> rider to autopass the third vote)

Yes. It is usable "after" (not during) a successful referendum.
